explication: LLPhant is a PHP library for generative-AI applications, LLM providers, and vector databases. Its main runtime capabilities include chat and tool calling, document embeddings and vector storage for semantic search, typed Jev classification, and evaluation; it also provides audio, image, and search tools. The graph combines sampled call sites and SOURCE INDEX references with README-described capabilities. Some domain modules are represented by their exact source directories because their implementations were not sampled; unverified connections are omitted.
